method: Remove unsuccessful API attempt durations and configured backoff; retain final successful attempt. Model-slot queue waits are not separately logged. Retrieval has six local slots per model, with two workers in original runs and at most four in correction batch, so no slot-capacity queue wait is expected; zero queue time is an inference from concurrency limits, not a measured decomposition. Gemini downtime correction is inherited from gemini_latency.json. Reader/grader calls are excluded.
